name: Camp Vacamas Sleepaway Camp
description_short: Nonprofit overnight camp on a lake in West Milford with 12 and 19 day sessions for ages 6 to 17. Campers swim, canoe, climb, do a ropes course and zip line, and play sports, and fees follow a sliding scale based on family income.
swim_waterfront_notes: Waterfront activities are run by American Red Cross certified swim instructors and lifeguards with a waterfront director.
notes: Session prices are the top tier for household income over $150,000. Lower tiers by income: under $70,000 pays $685 for Session 1 and $1,055 for Sessions 2 or 3; $70,001 to $100,000 pays $925 and $1,470; $100,001 to $150,000 pays $1,195 and $1,885. Every session adds a nonrefundable $90 registration fee ($60 for additional trips). Free buses from New York City, Westchester and selected New Jersey locations. Sibling discounts available. No parent visits during sessions. The same organization runs a day camp and a teen camp, listed separately if at all.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer 2027 sleepaway dates and income tier prices. The page states HI4Y, home to Camp Vacamas, is accredited by the American Camp Association. An older line on the same page quotes $1,025 to $2,305 for 19 day sessions; I used the 2027 tier table.
